authority: Secondary software implementation cross-index for existing DFT Research Workflow tasks.
scope_note: This bridge names the first official implementation entry for the same scientific task. It is not a software manual, compatibility promise, benchmark, ranking, or claim that different codes are numerically equivalent.

tasks.title: Fixed-geometry SCF
tasks.scientific_action: Converge the electronic state for one declared structure without moving atoms or changing the cell.
tasks.required_parent_object: An audited structure and cell, composition, method, basis or pseudopotential identities, Brillouin-zone sampling, occupations, charge, and spin intent.
tasks.validation_requirement: Inspect program completion and electronic convergence separately, then check that the converged state is the intended physical and numerical reference.
tasks.non_equivalence: Program completion is not SCF convergence, and SCF convergence is not proof that the reference state, numerical setup, or physical model is valid.

implementations.terminology: pw.x with calculation='scf'
required_inputs: pw.x input with the fixed structure and cell
pseudopotential files with preserved identities
declared k-point, occupation, charge, and spin setup
artifacts: charge density and wavefunctions when written
implementations.first_inspection: Confirm normal termination and the achieved SCF threshold separately; then inspect total energy, occupations, magnetization when relevant, and the exact prefix/outdir lineage.
implementations.boundary: JOB DONE is not SCF convergence, and a converged pw.x state is not automatically a trusted reference state.

implementations.terminology: Electronic ground-state calculation and electronic minimization
required_inputs: POSCAR, INCAR, and KPOINTS for a fixed structure
licensed POTCAR selected outside DRW
declared charge, occupation, and magnetic initialization
implementations.first_inspection: Check whether the electronic loop met its criterion rather than merely reaching NELM; then inspect energy, forces, stress, occupations, and the final magnetic state.
implementations.boundary: OUTCAR, CHGCAR, or WAVECAR can exist without a converged or scientifically suitable reference state.

implementations.terminology: abinit ground-state SCF calculation
implementations.first_official_start: Basic tutorial: total energy and related quantities
required_inputs: ABI input for the fixed geometry and cell
pseudopotential files with preserved identities
declared basis, k-point, occupation, charge, and spin setup
implementations.first_inspection: Read the run log for errors and warnings, then inspect the SCF stopping criterion and the final state in the .abo or _GSR.nc artifact.
implementations.boundary: A completed .abo or a written _GSR.nc file is not by itself evidence of SCF convergence or reference-state validity.

implementations.terminology: Quickstep DFT with RUN_TYPE ENERGY or ENERGY_FORCE and DFT/SCF
required_inputs: CP2K input with coordinates, cell, and the intended RUN_TYPE
basis-set and potential identities
declared SCF, k-point, occupation, charge, and spin setup
artifacts: generated input restart file when enabled
implementations.first_inspection: Confirm the SCF convergence marker and iteration history, then inspect final energy, forces or stress when requested, and the exact PROJECT and method identity.
implementations.boundary: ENERGY_FORCE evaluates forces but does not optimize geometry, and a WFN or restart file is not proof of convergence or compatibility.

tasks.title: Geometry or cell optimization
tasks.scientific_action: Relax declared atomic and, when intended, cell degrees of freedom on one stated potential-energy surface.
tasks.required_parent_object: An audited starting structure, a force-capable electronic setup and, when cell degrees of freedom are active, a stress-capable setup; explicit constraints and free degrees of freedom; and the intended external stress or pressure condition when applicable.
tasks.validation_requirement: Inspect every active ionic and cell stopping criterion, the last electronic steps, constraints, final geometry, forces, and, when applicable, stress before accepting the optimized structure or handing it to a separate static reference calculation.
tasks.non_equivalence: Electronic convergence is not ionic or cell convergence; reaching a step limit or writing a final structure is not a successful optimization.

implementations.terminology: pw.x with calculation='relax' or calculation='vc-relax'
required_inputs: audited starting structure and cell
force-quality SCF and pseudopotential setup
explicit atomic constraints and intended cell degrees of freedom
artifacts: stdout with ionic and electronic histories
implementations.first_inspection: Check the final complete force block component by component, honoring constraints; for vc-relax also inspect stress, cell criteria, and the final lattice.
implementations.boundary: relax and vc-relax solve different problems; aggregate Total force alone does not establish the force gate, and a final static SCF remains separate.

implementations.terminology: Structure optimization controlled by IBRION, NSW, and ISIF
required_inputs: audited POSCAR and compatible electronic setup
declared ionic and cell degrees of freedom
selective-dynamics constraints and stopping criteria
implementations.first_inspection: Check electronic convergence at each ionic step, the actual stop reason, all relevant forces and stress components, constraints, and the final cell and coordinates.
implementations.boundary: A CONTCAR written at NSW or another stop is not proof of ionic or cell convergence, and optimization output is not a substitute for a final static reference run.

implementations.terminology: Geometry optimization with geoopt or ionmov, with optcell for cell relaxation
required_inputs: audited starting geometry and electronic setup
declared geoopt or ionmov algorithm and stopping criteria
optcell, constraints, and target stress when cell relaxation is intended
artifacts: final GSR and geometry artifacts when written
implementations.first_inspection: Inspect warnings, active force and stress criteria, the actual termination condition, and the last positions and cell recorded in .abo and HIST.nc.
implementations.boundary: HIST.nc preserves a trajectory but does not prove convergence; fixed-cell and variable-cell optimizations must not be treated as interchangeable.

implementations.terminology: RUN_TYPE GEO_OPT with MOTION/GEO_OPT or RUN_TYPE CELL_OPT with MOTION/CELL_OPT
required_inputs: audited coordinates, cell, and force-evaluation method
declared GEO_OPT or CELL_OPT degrees of freedom
constraints, stress method, target pressure, and stopping criteria
implementations.first_inspection: Inspect all active maximum and RMS force and displacement criteria; for CELL_OPT also check pressure or stress, the final cell, and the last SCF cycles.
implementations.boundary: Reaching MAX_ITER or writing .restart is not convergence; GEO_OPT is not CELL_OPT, and neither is a finite-temperature equilibrium calculation.

tasks.title: Band path
tasks.scientific_action: Evaluate Kohn-Sham eigenvalues along an explicit reciprocal-space path from a trusted reference state.
tasks.required_parent_object: A converged and identifiable reference density or state at the exact structure and method, plus an explicit path convention, labels, energy reference, and sufficient band count.
tasks.validation_requirement: Verify reference-state lineage, path coordinates and labels, band count and eigenvalue convergence, and the energy zero before interpreting the plot.
tasks.non_equivalence: A high-symmetry path is not full-Brillouin-zone evidence for metallicity, global band extrema, a Fermi surface, or an indirect gap.

implementations.terminology: pw.x bands calculation followed by bands.x
required_inputs: trusted pw.x reference state in the same prefix/outdir
explicit k-point path and labels
declared number of bands and energy reference
artifacts: pw.x band eigenvalues along the path
implementations.first_inspection: Confirm the prefix/outdir lineage, exact path and labels, band count, eigenvalue convergence, and the Fermi or valence reference used for plotting.
implementations.boundary: bands.x ordering or formatting does not establish convergence, and a path plot does not establish full-zone metallicity or global extrema.

implementations.terminology: DFT band structure via KPOINTS_OPT or a fixed-density ICHARG=11 continuation
required_inputs: converged regular-mesh DFT reference and compatible CHGCAR for the split route
explicit line path or KPOINTS_OPT path
sufficient NBANDS and the SCF energy reference
implementations.first_inspection: Identify which official route was used, preserve the parent density, inspect the exact path, band count, orbital convergence, and reuse the SCF Fermi reference rather than a path-only estimate.
implementations.boundary: The ordinary ICHARG=11 fixed-density route is for normal DFT band calculations; hybrid band structures require a different official route and must not use that ordinary fixed-density shortcut.

implementations.terminology: Fixed-potential NSCF band calculation with iscf=-2
implementations.first_official_start: Basic tutorial: crystalline structure and band structure
required_inputs: trusted ground-state density from the same model
explicit k-point path convention and labels
declared band count and wavefunction tolerance
implementations.first_inspection: Confirm density handoff, fixed-potential setup, path convention, number of occupied and empty bands, wavefunction convergence, and the chosen energy zero.
implementations.boundary: A fixed-potential Kohn-Sham path is not a quasiparticle band structure and does not prove full-zone extrema or the experimental gap.

implementations.terminology: DFT/PRINT/BAND_STRUCTURE with KPOINT_SET
required_inputs: converged SCF state on an appropriate DFT/KPOINTS integration mesh
explicit BAND_STRUCTURE/KPOINT_SET path
declared ADDED_MOS and compatible diagonalization route
implementations.first_inspection: Distinguish the SCF integration mesh from the plotted path, then inspect path coordinates, added bands, energy reference, and current feature compatibility for k-point calculations.
implementations.boundary: DFT/KPOINTS is an SCF integration set, not the band path; a successful path calculation is not full-zone evidence, and CP2K feature compatibility is version and method dependent.

tasks.title: Dense DOS or PDOS
tasks.scientific_action: Evaluate total and projected electronic states from a sufficiently dense full-zone sampling of one trusted reference state.
tasks.required_parent_object: A trusted reference state, a target-converged uniform Brillouin-zone mesh, declared occupations and energy zero, and an explicit projection definition for PDOS.
tasks.validation_requirement: Check mesh and weights, occupations or tetrahedra, energy reference, unoccupied-state coverage, normalization, and projection completeness before interpreting peaks or states at the Fermi level.
tasks.non_equivalence: A smooth curve is not a convergence test; broadening cannot replace k-point convergence, and projected weights are not a unique charge partition.

implementations.terminology: Dense pw.x NSCF calculation followed by dos.x or projwfc.x
required_inputs: trusted pw.x SCF reference in the same prefix/outdir
dense uniform full-zone NSCF mesh and sufficient bands
declared occupations, energy window, and projection intent
artifacts: projwfc.x total and projected DOS files
implementations.first_inspection: Inspect k-point weights and mesh density, occupations, energy zero, band coverage, DOS normalization, and whether the projected channels account for the intended states.
implementations.boundary: A high-symmetry band path cannot supply a DOS, smoothing cannot repair sparse sampling, and projwfc weights are basis-dependent projections.

implementations.terminology: Dense regular-mesh DOS calculation with DOSCAR and optional LORBIT projections
required_inputs: trusted compatible reference state
dense uniform KPOINTS mesh and sufficient NBANDS
declared smearing or tetrahedron and LORBIT projection setup
implementations.first_inspection: Check the uniform mesh, integration method, energy zero, unoccupied-state range, NEDOS resolution, and the LORBIT-dependent projection definition.
implementations.boundary: DOSCAR existence or a visually smooth DOS does not prove k-point convergence, and atom-orbital projections remain method dependent.

implementations.terminology: Electronic DOS with prtdos and optional partial-DOS controls
required_inputs: trusted compatible ground-state setup
dense uniform k-point sampling and sufficient bands
declared prtdos method, energy grid, and projection spheres
artifacts: partial or orbital-weighted DOS when requested
implementations.first_inspection: Inspect the k mesh and weights, prtdos integration method, energy increment and zero, normalization, band coverage, and atom-sphere projection choices.
implementations.boundary: A smooth _DOS curve does not establish sampling convergence, and partial DOS depends on the declared projection construction.

implementations.terminology: DFT/PRINT/DOS with PDOS subsections
required_inputs: trusted Quickstep state and a converged DFT/KPOINTS mesh
sufficient molecular orbitals above the occupied states
declared energy zero, projection selections, and broadening
implementations.first_inspection: Check the installed CP2K version, full-zone mesh, orbital coverage, energy zero, projection selections, and both raw and broadened outputs.
implementations.boundary: The unified DOS/PDOS and CURVE interface described here requires CP2K 2026.2 or later; Gamma-only molecular levels and broadened curves are not a converged periodic DOS.

tasks.title: Harmonic phonons
tasks.scientific_action: Evaluate harmonic vibrational modes from a trusted stationary structure using a declared q-grid or supercell route.
tasks.required_parent_object: A trusted relaxed or stationary structure, tighter force-quality electronic convergence, a declared q-grid or displacement supercell, and the symmetry and long-range electrostatic treatment required by the material.
tasks.validation_requirement: Check the parent stationary state, electronic and phonon thresholds, q or supercell coverage, acoustic behavior, mode eigenvectors, and sensitivity of any imaginary or near-zero frequency.
tasks.non_equivalence: An imaginary frequency can be physical or numerical; Gamma-only modes are not a full phonon dispersion, and enforcing an acoustic sum rule cannot repair unconverged force constants.

implementations.terminology: ph.x to q2r.x to matdyn.x
required_inputs: trusted pw.x reference state at the stationary structure
declared irreducible q points or regular q mesh
tight electronic and response thresholds
implementations.first_inspection: Check that every required q point completed and converged, then inspect acoustic modes, sum-rule sensitivity, eigenvectors, and the q-mesh dependence of negative frequencies.
implementations.boundary: One Gamma calculation is not a dispersion; an imaginary mode may be physical or numerical, and post-processing cannot rescue unconverged dynamical matrices.

implementations.terminology: Finite-difference or DFPT force constants followed by phonon dispersion or DOS
implementations.first_official_start: Computing the phonon dispersion and DOS
required_inputs: trusted equilibrium structure and tightly converged forces
declared finite-displacement supercell or supported DFPT route
QPOINTS path or uniform q mesh and version-compatible phonon controls
artifacts: phonon dispersion or DOS output for the declared route
implementations.first_inspection: Check the stationary parent, supercell and displacement or DFPT route, electronic convergence, q sampling, acoustic modes, and the eigenvectors of negative frequencies.
implementations.boundary: Finite differences and DFPT have different requirements; zone-center output is not full-q stability, and native dispersion features are version dependent.

implementations.terminology: DFPT with abinit, DDB assembly, and anaddb interpolation
required_inputs: trusted ground state at the stationary structure
complete symmetry-reduced perturbations on a regular q grid
declared non-analytic, charge-neutrality, and interpolation setup
implementations.first_inspection: Verify that the DDB contains every required irreducible perturbation and q point, then inspect anaddb settings, acoustic behavior, LO-TO treatment, and negative-mode sensitivity.
implementations.boundary: DDB existence is not DDB completeness; Gamma modes are not a full dispersion, and interpolation cannot replace converged electronic and q-grid inputs.

implementations.terminology: RUN_TYPE VIBRATIONAL_ANALYSIS with finite-difference normal modes
required_inputs: tightly optimized stationary structure
very tightly converged force evaluation
declared finite-difference displacement and periodicity treatment
implementations.first_inspection: Confirm the stationary parent and tight SCF convergence, then inspect displacement sensitivity, low modes, translational or rotational cleanup, and mode eigenvectors.
implementations.boundary: This entry is for Gamma-point normal modes and is not a general-q phonon dispersion workflow; thermochemistry is also limited to the documented molecular Gamma-point scope.

tasks.title: Restart or continuation
tasks.scientific_action: Continue an interrupted calculation or deliberately hand a preserved state to a compatible next calculation without losing ancestry.
tasks.required_parent_object: An identifiable parent run with exact code and version, model and method identities, structure and state files, stop point, hashes or equivalent identities, and a written statement of what will be restored.
tasks.validation_requirement: Inspect ancestry and compatibility before launch, then distinguish same-run restart, electronic-state initialization, geometry handoff, and a scientifically new calculation.
tasks.non_equivalence: A restart file is not proof of compatible ancestry; density, wavefunction, geometry, optimizer, and scheduler continuation are distinct handoffs.

implementations.terminology: restart_mode='restart' for the same interrupted pw.x calculation
required_inputs: the preserved prefix.save tree and required wavefunctions
the same prefix, outdir, calculation type, structure, and method
recorded interruption point and parent output
artifacts: wavefunction and ionic-history data used by the same run
implementations.first_inspection: Verify exact parent ancestry, prefix/outdir ownership, preserved files, code and input compatibility, and whether the previous run stopped cleanly enough to restart.
implementations.boundary: restart_mode continues the same compatible calculation ancestry; reading a saved density for a changed task is a new calculation and is not the same restart claim.

implementations.terminology: ISTART from WAVECAR, ICHARG from CHGCAR, or explicit CONTCAR-to-POSCAR geometry handoff
required_inputs: preserved WAVECAR, CHGCAR, or CONTCAR selected for the intended handoff
compatible structure, cell, basis, k mesh, method, charge, and spin setup
parent OUTCAR and stop reason
artifacts: new WAVECAR and CHGCAR when written
new CONTCAR for an ionic continuation
implementations.first_inspection: Identify whether the ancestry is wavefunction, charge-density, or geometry based; check parent compatibility, chosen POSCAR, magnetic state, and whether the run actually read the intended file.
implementations.boundary: WAVECAR, CHGCAR, and CONTCAR carry different ancestry; their presence does not prove compatibility, and a fixed-charge continuation is not a same-state SCF restart.

implementations.terminology: getwfk or getden dataset handoff, external WFK or DEN reads, and restartxf from HIST.nc
required_inputs: identified WFK, DEN, GSR, or HIST parent artifact
compatible dataset, structure, cell, pseudopotential, basis, and method
parent log, .abo output, and stop point
artifacts: new WFK, DEN, GSR, or HIST files
implementations.first_inspection: Confirm the exact source dataset or external file, inspect log errors, model compatibility, and whether density, wavefunctions, cell, positions, or optimizer history are actually being restored.
implementations.boundary: A get variable, an external file read, and restartxf express different ancestry; density is not wavefunction, and HIST reconstruction is not a generic new-run shortcut.

implementations.terminology: EXT_RESTART for selected saved run state
required_inputs: identified .restart input and the parent files selected for restoration
compatible PROJECT, structure, cell, basis, potential, method, and k-point formalism
explicit EXT_RESTART selections and parent output
artifacts: new state artifacts requested by the continued calculation
implementations.first_inspection: Verify parent ancestry, every state component selected by EXT_RESTART, and that each restored artifact belongs to the declared parent run.
implementations.boundary: EXT_RESTART restores only selected saved state; omitted, incompatible, or unintended components can change the continuation, and a restart artifact is not proof of convergence.
